failure.interpretation: The independent inspector counted the generated kernel-identity preamble as a source course cell and used original unfinished-cell indices directly in the executed notebook. The verifier intentionally inserts one execution-only preamble at index zero; manifest counts/indices refer to the source notebook. Corrected review must exclude this preamble, offset source indices by one, and check that original unfinished source and IDs remain unchanged while skip-verification tags prevent execution.
